summary: First iteration end-to-end tests for YABBAI Forge · $BASH Flywheel. Backend pytest suite (22 tests) — all passed. Frontend Playwright coverage of Home, Pricing, Mission Control, Flywheel and Pulse pages — all critical flows working. Live external APIs (pump.fun, DexScreener, Jupiter, Solana RPC) responding; simulated buybacks and payments working as designed. One minor selector-naming mismatch in FlowDiagram data-testids vs review-request expectation (loop/convert/inject vs cycle-taps/conversion/injection).

action_items: OPTIONAL: Rename FlowDiagram node ids to match the review request testids (loop->cycle-taps, convert->conversion, inject->injection) or update product spec. All 8 nodes render, so purely a testid naming alignment.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @on_event('startup'/'shutdown'); prefer lifespan context manager to avoid runtime deprecation warnings.

routers/withdrawals.py: TOCTOU risk between vault_summary() check and inserting withdrawal — two concurrent withdraws could exceed available balance. Consider a DB-level atomic decrement / transaction.
routers/payments.py trusts client-provided amount_usd derivation; ok for demo (SIMULATED) but should be flagged if this ever goes to production.
